newsitem.title: INDIA: India 96/97 rice buying to June 23 at 12.5 mln T.
newsitem.headline: India 96/97 rice buying to June 23 at 12.5 mln T.

text.p: Indian agencies have bought 12.5 million tonnes of rice from farmers in the 1996/97 (Oct-Sept) season up to June 23, compared with 9.9 million on the same date last year, an Agriculture Ministry statement said on Wednesday.
The government buys rice from farmers to build up buffer stocks. It then control prices by releasing the grain through its public distribution system. --New Delhi newsroom +91-11 301 2024
